description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Wind with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Spellblade Mode I: Bartz - Wind] and [Spellblade Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Attach Wind with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Wind Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Wind 3

description.name: Dual Awoken Spellblade Mode I: Bartz - Wind
description.text: Spellblade abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Spellblade abilities trigger 2 additional times, casts Dual Spellblade Whirlwind after casting an equipped Spellblade ability

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants [Instant ATB 1], [Attach Wind 2 with Stacking], [Dual Wind Spellblade Mode], [Dual Awoken Spellblade Mode II: Bartz - Wind], removes [Dual Awoken Spellblade Mode I: Bartz - Wind]
